6277.title: Catalog details omit close arbitration
6277.rootCauseOneLine: The built-in catalog never registers panel.close or a desktop close-request listener, so visible detail tabs leave window-close requests unhandled.

prReviews.topFinding: Registers both existing close entry points; no linked branch was run.

6277.proposedFix: Route the panel command and desktop listener through one visible-active-detail callback that reuses closeTab and preserves unhandled fallback.
6277.caveats: Renderer reproduction on Linux, not a native macOS menu test. Same agent repeated the reproduction in a second clean checkout.
